_meta.indication: STENDRA is a phosphodiesterase 5 (PDE5) inhibitor indicated for the treatment of erectile dysfunction.

pivotal_trials.design: Multi-center, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial with a 4-week run-in period and a 12-week treatment period; subjects randomized 1:1:1:1 to placebo, avanafil 50 mg, 100 mg, or 200 mg.
pivotal_trials.population: Adult men (≥18 years) with mild to severe erectile dysfunction of at least 6 months duration; diabetic patients and prostatectomy patients excluded.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Three co-primary endpoints: change in percentage of sexual attempts with successful intercourse (SEP3), change in percentage of attempts with successful vaginal penetration (SEP2), and change in IIEF erectile function domain score.
pivotal_trials.result: In TA-301, treatment effect over placebo on SEP3 was 13.8% (p=0.0002), 29.3% (p<0.0001), and 30.2% (p<0.0001) for avanafil 50, 100, and 200 mg; IIEF EF domain difference vs placebo was 2.6 (p=0.0014), 5.5 (p<0.0001), and 6.7 (p<0.0001).

nct_ctgov.title: Research Evaluating an Investigational Medication for Erectile Dysfunction - General ED

pivotal_trials.design: Multi-center, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial with a 4-week run-in and 12-week treatment period; subjects randomized 1:1:1 to placebo, avanafil 100 mg, or 200 mg.
pivotal_trials.population: Adult men (≥18 years) with mild to severe erectile dysfunction of at least 6 months duration who had documented type 1 or type 2 diabetes (n=390).
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Same three co-primary endpoints: change in SEP3, SEP2, and IIEF erectile function domain score.
pivotal_trials.result: In TA-302, SEP3 treatment effect over placebo was 15.2% (p<0.0001) for avanafil 100 mg and 20.4% (p<0.0001) for 200 mg; IIEF EF domain difference vs placebo was 2.8 (p=0.0017) and 3.6 (p<0.0001).

nct_ctgov.title: Research Evaluating an Investigational Medication for Erectile Dysfunction - Diabetic ED (REVIVE-D)

key_safety: Most common adverse events (>2% of subjects and more frequent than placebo) were headache, flushing, nasopharyngitis, and back pain. In the pivotal trials headache occurred in 1.4% (placebo), 4.4% (50 mg), 5.9% (100 mg), and 10.2% (200 mg); flushing in 0.0% (placebo), 3.8% (50 mg), 4.2% (100 mg), and 3.8% (200 mg).
target_moa: Avanafil is a selective inhibitor of cGMP-specific PDE5; by inhibiting PDE5 it prevents degradation of cGMP in the corpus cavernosum, enhancing nitric-oxide-mediated smooth muscle relaxation and penile blood inflow during sexual stimulation.

rems.type: The review teams determined that a REMS was not necessary for this product.

advisory_committee.vote: No Advisory Committee was convened; the safety issues associated with PDE5 inhibitor therapies are well known and can be adequately labeled, and no new safety concerns were identified for avanafil.

description.text: Added efficacy/safety data showing avanafil onset approximately 15 minutes after dosing for erectile dysfunction treatment

citations.quote: This “Prior Approval” supplemental application provides for revisions to the Prescribing Information with safety and efficacy information from Study TA-501 entitled “*A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Evaluation of Avanafil for On-Demand Treatment of Men with Erectile Dysfunction.*” The study was conducted to examine the therapeutic effects of two doses of avanafil (100 mg and 200 mg) approximately 15 minutes after dosing.

description.text: Labeling update to add results of the PMR semen/spermatogenesis study and PLLR pregnancy/lactation revisions; no change to indication

citations.quote: - Updates to the prescribing information in Section 12.2 to reflect the results of your Post Marketing Requirement semen study. These revisions summarize the findings of the aforementioned PMR clinical trial.

summary.text: Standard full approval of avanafil (Stendra), a PDE5 inhibitor, for erectile dysfunction, based on two adequate and well-controlled Phase 3 trials (TA-301 and TA-302); no Advisory Committee was convened and no REMS was required, with two postmarketing requirements (sperm and vision studies).

citations.quote: Based on the submitted efficacy results from two adequate and well-controlled trials (Studies TA-301 and TA-302) for Stendra, it is reasonable to conclude that the proposed Applicant’s product will be efficacious for the treatment of erectile dysfunction.

requirement.text: 1889-2: A double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled, single-dose vision clinical trial to assess the effects of avanafil on multiple parameters of vision, including visual acuity, intraocular pressure, pupillometry, and color vision discrimination, in healthy male subjects.

citations.quote: 1889-2: A double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled, single-dose vision clinical trial to assess the effects of avanafil on multiple parameters of vision, including, but not limited to visual acuity, intraocular pressure, pupillometry, and color vision discrimination, in healthy male subjects.
